characteristics repeatedly applied to the alternating current input terminals (no other
power connected to terminals) without failure of the test specimen:
- Amplitude: 1000 volts +5 percent, both positive and negative polarity.
- Energy Source: Capacitor, oil filled, 15 microfarads +10percent, internal surge
impedance less than 1 ohm.
- Repetition: Applied to the CA once every 2 seconds for a maximum of three
applications for each polarity.
- After the foregoing, the CA shall perform all defined functions upon the application of
nominal alternating current power.
